principle: Creativity must not be simulated by volume. Budget limits are frozen before BB-Prop-01 blind evaluation.

threshold_selection_rule.when_exact_values_unknown: Use panel cardinality and observation-class cardinality to set budgets proportional to evidence surface, never proportional to desired hit rate
threshold_selection_rule.rationale: sqrt scaling prevents combinatorial explosion while allowing multiple falsifiable angles on rich observations

frozen_limits_v1.note: Values justified from 3I.0 finding that 24 template families already saturate planner; autonomous layer must stay sparse

deduplication.within_observation: Collapse propositions with embedding similarity >= 0.90 keeping highest grounding score
deduplication.within_session: Collapse across observations if canonical_proposition_core equivalent
deduplication.cross_session: Not enforced in v1 — logged for lineage only

generate_nothing_when: All candidates fail grounding or falsifiability
Negative control scenario (pure noise, duplicated evidence)

anti_spam_invariants.hypothesis_spam_definition: Session with >50 propositions OR >15 survivors OR <20% grounding rate OR >60% TEMPLATE_INSTANCE rate
anti_spam_invariants.penalty: Session flagged PATHOLOGICAL_SPAM — excluded from creativity metrics numerator
anti_spam_invariants.no_reward_for_count: Metrics use rates and survivors, never raw proposition count

development_vs_blind.blind_benchmark: Budget frozen; exceeding cap is automatic disqualification of excess propositions (lowest grounding score dropped first)
